note: Multipliers on the Oman gain K for the synthetic label (PRD 4.1). Literature gives direction only; every magnitude is a guess and is drawn per ride from the range so the model cannot fit one value. Tier 1 airflow is never included.

rear_seat.source: Schmidt et al. 2020 (3,999 survey); Turner and Griffin 1999; Irmak et al. 2021

noise.source: Gu et al. 2025; no evidence for ordinary cabin noise
